prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: webhook-relay
description: Accepts webhook requests and forwards them to a target URL with retries.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /webhooks
  description: 'body {url: absolute http(s) URL, payload: any JSON}; 202 when queued
    for delivery; 400 for missing/invalid url or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /webhooks/stats
  description: '200 {delivered: n, failed: n, pending: n}'
metrics:
- name: webhook_deliveries_total
  type: counter
  help: Successful deliveries
- name: webhook_failures_total
  type: counter
  help: Deliveries that failed after all retries
- name: webhook_pending
  type: gauge
  help: Deliveries queued or in progress
behaviors:
- 'Delivery is asynchronous: POSTs the payload as JSON to url; retries up to 3 attempts
  total on network error or non-2xx, with a short backoff (<= 100ms in tests; keep
  it configurable via a package variable)'
- Tests use httptest.NewServer as the delivery target
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /webhooks
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"payload": {}}'
- method: POST
  path: /webhooks
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"url": "not-a-url", "payload": {}}'
- method: POST
  path: /webhooks
  expect_status:
  - 202
  body: '{"url": "http://127.0.0.1:1/x", "payload": {"a": 1}}'
- method: GET
  path: /webhooks/stats
  expect_status:
  - 200
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- webhookDeliveriesTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `webhook_deliveries_total`; use Inc/Add
- webhookFailuresTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `webhook_failures_total`; use Inc/Add
- webhookPending  (gauge) -> exposed as `webhook_pending`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /webhooks  body {url: absolute http(s) URL, payload: any JSON}; 202 when queued for delivery; 400 for missing/invalid url or malformed JSON
   - GET /webhooks/stats  200 {delivered: n, failed: n, pending: n}
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
